models.title: Foreign exchange quote conversion
models.summary: Base-currency amount purchased with a price-currency sum at a price-per-base quote, by division.

relationship.locator: PDF: LM3 solution 33 (Delgado hedge roll), printed p. 236 (PDF p. 244): sell USD2,500,000 at the all-in forward 0.8944 -> USD2,500,000/0.8944 = EUR2,795,169.95; buy USD2,500,000 at the spot 0.8875 -> USD2,500,000/0.8875 = EUR2,816,901.41; net outflow EUR21,731.46
relationship.translation_notes: Currency units. Quote in price currency per one unit of base; division inverts the price.

variables.definition: Sum in the price currency, in currency units
Exchange quote in price currency per base unit, decimal
Amount in the base currency, in currency units

assumptions: Single conversion at the quoted (bid or offer) side; quote and sum in matching currencies.
limitations: Conversion only; bid/offer choice and hedge rebalancing are separate.

models.title: Semiannual interest accrual on notional
models.summary: Period interest as notional times the period rate times the 180/360 year fraction.

relationship.original_equation: Interest = Notional x rate x 180/360 (Example 7 periodic flows)
relationship.locator: PDF: LM2 Example 7 (CAD-USD cross-currency basis swap), printed p. 97 (PDF p. 105): swap receipt CAD50M x 1.80% x 180/360 = CAD450,000; bank-loan payment CAD50M x (1.95%+0.65%) x 180/360 = CAD650,000
relationship.translation_notes: Currency units; decimals. t is the 180/360 semiannual year fraction (0.5).

variables.definition: Year fraction for the accrual period, decimal
Interest for the period, in currency units

assumptions: Simple (uncompounded) accrual for the stated period; rate already includes spreads/basis.
limitations: Single-period accrual only; compounding across periods is separate.
